newsitem.title: USA: Syquest sees improvement in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Syquest sees improvement in Q3.

text.p: SyQuest Technology Inc said Friday that it expects third quarter results to show both increased revenue and reduced losses over both the previous 1997 second quarter and 1996's third quarter.
For the second quarter ended March 31, 1997, SyQuest reported a net loss of $33.7 million, or $1.31 per share, on net revenues of $16.8 million.
For the third fiscal quarter of 1996, SyQuest reported a net loss of $41.3 million, or $3.61 per share, on net revenues of $29.5 million.
The company said it completed volume shipments of its EZFlyer 230 and SyJet drives to "significant new corporate accounts" for use with laptop computers and corporate servers.
Syquest noted it has shipped the first of an estimated 50,000 EZFlyer and SyJet drives to institutions of higher learning in China, after successfully completing extensive product evaluations.
Cartridge sales for each drive installed are anticipated to be higher than usual due to multiple student usage of the drives.
